run_SanaPipeline_fast_tests: run the SanaPipelineFastTests unittest class to test SanaPipeline with dummy transformer, VAE, and scheduler components
run_SanaPipeline_integration_tests: run the SanaPipelineIntegrationTests to validate Sana 1024px and 512px pretrained models against expected output slices
test_callback_inputs: test the SanaPipeline callback_on_step_end functionality to verify tensor inputs passed during each inference step
test_attention_slicing: test the SanaPipeline attention slicing forward pass to verify slicing does not affect inference results
test_vae_tiling: test the SanaPipeline VAE tiling feature to verify tiled decoding produces results close to non-tiled decoding
